_about: Independent Media Network (imnetwork.com.au): website subscription for small businesses. Edited by chat. Prices are ex-GST; IMN is GST-registered. setup.promo true = launch offer (setup waived); set false to start charging setup.normal.

hero.title: Your website, built and looked after, for $1 a day.
hero.lede: We build your site, host it, keep it healthy on Google and make your changes. Human run, AI powered. No lock-in.

included.t: A site built for your business
included.d: Up to 5 pages, designed for phones first, written with you. Not a template you fill in yourself.
Fast pages on Cloudflare's global network, with the padlock (SSL) on. Every version is saved, so any change can be undone.
Page titles, descriptions, a sitemap and Google Search Console set up, then checked every month.
Email us what you want changed: new text, a photo, a price, a new section. We do it, you check it.
Visits, Google searches and enquiries in plain English, so you can see what the site is doing for you.
You email a person, not a ticket system. We reply within one business day.

steps.d: Two minutes on the form. If you already have a site, send us the link.
We write and design it, then send you a private link to check on your phone. Change what you like before it goes live.

steps.t: Go live, then we look after it
steps.d: We connect your domain, set up Google and keep everything running. You email us when you want a change.

ai.title: Human run, AI powered
paragraphs: We use AI to do the heavy lifting: drafting pages, checking speed and Google basics, and making changes quickly. That's how we keep the price at $1 a day.
A person runs every job. Simon plans your site with you, checks every page before it goes live and answers your emails himself. Nothing goes live without a human signing it off.

change: A change is a small update to your site: new or edited text, swapping photos, updating prices or opening hours, or adding a section to an existing page. Send a few small edits in one email and we count it as one round. A brand-new page or a redesign is quoted first.

faq.a: Yes. It's billed monthly at $30 + GST ($33). That covers hosting, security, Google upkeep, your dashboard and 2 changes a month.
Not during our launch offer: setup is free. After the launch it will be $199 + GST, once, for new sign-ups.

A small update: new or edited text, swapping photos, updating prices or opening hours, or a new section on an existing page. Several small edits sent together count as one round. Extra changes are $50 + GST a round. A brand-new page or a redesign is quoted first.
No. It's month to month. Tell us before your next month starts and we stop billing.
You own your domain name and your content. If you leave, we send you your site files and help you move your domain.

faq.q: Do I need a domain name?
faq.a: Yes, your own address like yourbusiness.com.au. Domains are bought in your business's name, usually about $20 to $30 a year from the registrar. We'll help you buy it, or connect the one you have.

faq.q: Do you use AI to build sites?
faq.a: Yes, for the heavy lifting, which is how the price stays low. A person plans your site with you, checks every page before it goes live and answers your emails.
We email a tax invoice each month. Nothing is charged until your site is live and you're happy with it.
Melbourne. We work with businesses anywhere in Australia, by email, phone or video call.
